lounges.name: KIX Lounge Kansai
lounges.location: International departures, after security and immigration; follow the KIX Lounge Kansai signs.

hours.note: ANA lists 06:00–00:55, with opening tied to security and closing tied to the last participating scheduled departure. Confirm the hours for your flight.

sources.title: ANA · Kansai lounge access and hours

lounges.note: This replaces the former ANA Lounge. Other airlines may issue invitations, but only the verified ANA access routes are included. Detailed operator facilities could not be rechecked.

qualityRating.summary: An April 2026 visit found the new shared lounge spacious, clean and comfortable, with a useful food selection and family facilities. This is one visit; peak-time conditions may differ.

lounges.name: KIX Lounge Premium
lounges.location: International departures; upstairs from the central duty-free area, after immigration.

sources.title: ANA · Kansai lounge access and hours

lounges.note: Separate from KIX Lounge Kansai. ANA Business Class and Star Alliance Gold alone do not qualify for Premium. JAL status, eligible Economy fares and other airline invitations need additional research; detailed operator facilities remain unverified.

qualityRating.summary: The MileLion’s May 2026 review praises the food, design and service of the new shared lounge. Showers were functional rather than luxurious, and the experience fell short of a flagship First lounge.

sources.title: The MileLion · KIX Lounge Premium, May 2026

lounges.name: Airport Cafe Lounge NODOKA
lounges.location: Landside, second floor of Aeroplaza, near the Terminal 2 shuttle stop.

hours.note: The operator confirms 24-hour lounge and shower service. Priority Pass uses 00:00–23:59 in its daily listing.

accessRules.label: Priority Pass
conditions: Confirm you have not used Priority Pass at this lounge in the previous 12 hours.

sources.title: NODOKA · Operator facilities, hours and Priority Pass FAQ

lounges.note: Departure visits only. The three-hour option includes two choices from a meal, two beers, or a 40-minute shower; bath towels cost extra. A separate paid extension option offers a discount rather than free longer access. Leave time for terminal transfers, security and any immigration requirements.

recommendation.summary: A landside option for a shower before entering the departure area; choose the shower as one of the included benefits.

qualityRating.summary: A March 2026 visit describes comfortable reclining booths and useful showers, but a basic cafe-style food offer and a separate landside building. Meal and shower choices depend on the entry package.
